# Kaede Project

> Kaede Project is a digital development company. It designs and builds websites, AI solutions, automations, CRM systems and custom digital platforms for businesses.

Kaede Project is available in English and Spanish. Spanish pricing is listed in Colombian pesos (COP), English pricing in US dollars (USD).

## Pages

- [Kaede Project (English)](https://kaedeproject.com/en): services, pricing, process, selected projects and FAQ.
- [Kaede Project (Español)](https://kaedeproject.com/es): servicios, precios, proceso, proyectos destacados y preguntas frecuentes.

## Services

- Web Development: landing pages, corporate websites, e-commerce, custom websites and web platforms.
- Artificial Intelligence: AI assistants, AI agents, AI integrations, content workflows and business-specific AI tools.
- Automation: workflow automation, lead routing, notifications, data synchronization, marketing and sales automation.
- CRM & Integrations: CRM implementation and customization, lead pipelines, API integrations and business dashboards.

## Pricing (English site)

- Landing Page: 300 USD
- Corporate Website: 450 USD
- E-commerce: 600 USD
- Custom Web Solution: quoted per project
